title: Make language of a node consider lang attribute on SVG elements.
body: The rules for finding the language of a node were made somewhat more formal in 11dc4c7557f5a4c879c1ce65b9cb59b91310bbf5 (PR #9796, fixing #3699). Both before and after that change they considered the lang attribute in the XML namespace, and the lang attribute in no namespace on HTML elements. However, the SVG spec at https://www.w3.org/TR/2018/CR-SVG2-20181004/struct.html#LangSpaceAttrs has very similar wording to the HTML spec prior to that edit, and also defined a lang attribute on SVG elements. This updates the language of a node algorithm in HTML to consider SVG elements as well, since implementing it as written (without this change) breaks the lang attribute in SVG. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium * Gecko (already implements) - [X] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://wpt.fyi/results/svg/text/reftests/lang-attribute.svg (failing on some engines, haven't investigated why) * https://wpt.fyi/results/svg/text/reftests/lang-attribute-dynamic.svg (implementing the spec as currently written broke this test, which is what made me notice this issue!) * web-platform-tests/wpt#42732 - [X] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: https://crbug.com/1490711 and https://crrev.com/c/4974775 * Gecko: already implements exactly this behavior (plus support in the XUL namespace), see [nsIContent::GetLang](https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/rev/ffdc4971dc18e1141cb2a90c2b0b776365650270/dom/base/FragmentOrElement.cpp#298-320) and [nsIContent::SupportsLangAttr](https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/rev/ffdc4971dc18e1141cb2a90c2b0b776365650270/dom/base/nsIContent.h#568-570) * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=263655 - [X] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: probably https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/lang and https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Attribute/lang are sufficient and no issue needs to be filed - [X] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use. (See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.) *** /dom.html ( diff )
